lines.text: You hear it too, don't you. Sit. The music's kept low so we can.
Nine listened first. We keep the volume down out of respect.
Halvard drinks two doors up. We don't mind. They mind.
Keep your voice down, please. Not for us.

barks.text: There. Under the bass. Did you hear it?
Solenne says we buy more than Sable does. That's not a sin. It's a ledger.
Follow the street to where it stops. That's Vesper's door. She doesn't sing.
Turn it down. Thank you. Now listen.
Some nights the whole room stops talking at once. Nobody decides to.
